limitations: Not a module-wide completion claim; raw-call inventory contains diagnostics/canonical APIs as well as remaining player messages.
General mutation_def gain/lose level arrays and body-part substitutions remain outside this batch.
Canonical ability details / costs / names APIs retain English; display-only menu path is new.
Complex curse, sacrifice and card costs intentionally force a complete canonical talent row; unsupported ability/god names also force whole-parent fallback.
god_power::display and external god_speaks database protocol, follower/ancestor logs, dynamic god-wrath/conduct messages beyond kill response remain.
Native full build, saved-game screenshots and Linux validation must be run by root.
